name: Porton Pharma Solutions Ltd.
summary: Porton Pharma Solutions Ltd. provides contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) solutions for small molecules, tides, biologics, and conjugates from pre-clinical to commercial in China and internationally. It has a strategic collaboration with Aojin Life Sciences to advance XDC conjugate drugs; and strategic partnership with Dragon Sail Pharmaceutical to build a new ecosystem for ADC drug development, production, and supply chain. It also offers crystallization, bio catalysis, metal catalysis, flow chemistry, prep-chromatography, and milling.
